summary: newcleo plc, a UK-incorporated advanced modular reactor and MOX fuel developer, closed its business combination with NewHold Investment Corp III (Nasdaq: NHIC), a Cayman SPAC, on September 21, 2026, following shareholder approval at a September 17 EGM. Gross proceeds totaled approximately $247 million — a $216 million oversubscribed PIPE plus $31 million from NewHold's trust — against a pre-money equity value of roughly $2.4 billion. Shares and public warrants trade on Nasdaq under NWCL and NWCLW from September 22, 2026. Up to $75 million more may be available under a previously disclosed forward purchase agreement. Watch warrant overhang, redemption-driven trust shrinkage, and PIPE resale registration timing.
